import urllib.request, time

pdb_ids = open('/app/pdb_ids.txt').read().split()

        url = f"https://www.rcsb.org/fasta/entry/{pid}/display"

            print(f"{pid}: {len(data)} bytes fetched")

            out.write(f">{pid} ERROR {e}\n")

import urllib.request, urllib.parse, json, time

# BLAST the antibody heavy chain variable region via NCBI URL API
heavy = "QVQLQQSAAELARPGASVKMSCKASGYSFTTYTIHWVKQRPGQGLEWIGYINPSSGYAAYNQNFKDETTLTADPSSSTAYMELNSLTSEDSAVYYCAREKFYGYDYWGQGATLTVSS"

for name, seq in [('heavy_v', heavy), ('light_v', light)]:
    params = urllib.parse.urlencode({
        'CMD': 'Put',
        'PROGRAM': 'blastp',
        'DATABASE': 'nr',
        'QUERY': seq,
        'HITLIST_SIZE': '10',
        'EXPECT': '0.001',
    })
    url = 'https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/blast/Blast.cgi?' + params
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
            html = r.read().decode(errors='replace')
        # Extract RID
        import re
        m = re.search(r'RID = (\S+)', html)
        if m:
            print(f"{name}: RID={m.group(1)}")
        else:
            print(f"{name}: no RID found, html snippet:")
            print(html[:500])
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{name}: ERROR {e}")
    time.sleep(1)
